title: Bodycam Footage of Milwaukee Police Officer Shooting Suspect Armed With Gun
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
The Milwaukee Police Department released on Friday, Sept. 27 a Community Briefing tied to the officer-involved shooting of Jamel Barnes. In this community briefing video, the Milwaukee Police Department provides an overview of the August 14, 2019, officer-involved shooting on the 3300 block of North 21st Street.
